method.title: Experiencing English with all the senses.
method.description: Six elements work together throughout the courses. Children encounter English in understandable situations through voice, movement, materials and their own active participation.

spotlight.title: Listen. Join in. Speak.
spotlight.description: English is used naturally during the course and made understandable through situations, facial expressions, gestures and repetition.

immersion.title: Immersion method
immersion.description: English is experienced as a living course language. Meaning emerges from context, facial expressions, gestures and repetition.

songs.title: Children's songs
songs.description: Melody and rhythm help children recognise new sounds, words and sentence patterns.

rhymes.title: Nursery rhymes
rhymes.description: Nursery rhymes combine pronunciation, speech rhythm and repetition in short, memorable forms.

movement.title: Play and movement
movement.description: Movement and shared play connect language with action and keep children actively involved.

materials.title: Learning materials
materials.description: Objects, images and creative activities make words and relationships visible and tangible.

senses.title: Learning with all the senses
senses.description: Multiple sensory impressions give new words meaning and create varied anchors for memory.

cambridge.title: A clear plan for the right Cambridge exam.
cambridge.description: Preparation combines long-term language development with a clear understanding of the exam format, the four language skills and each learner's appropriate next step.

result.title: Cambridge exams passed
result.description: Across the exams prepared through SprachOase since 2014.

path.title: Each level builds on the one before.
path.description: Cambridge English Qualifications are aligned to the Common European Framework of Reference. The right exam depends on the learner's current level and goals.
